title: Strict TDD enforcement
description: Turns GSD's advisory TDD gate into a blocking one. At execute:post, every type:tdd plan in the phase must carry a RED commit (test(<phase>-<plan>)) that is an ancestor of its GREEN commit (feat(<phase>-<plan>)); otherwise the phase does not seal. Enforcement honesty: a capability gate fires only at GSD loop extension points reached inside a GSD command. Code written outside a GSD command never crosses a loop point and is never seen by this capability — pair it with a tool-call-boundary guard for that.

tdd-strict.enabled.description: Block phase completion when a type:tdd plan is missing its RED or GREEN gate commit, or when RED does not precede GREEN.
